diagnoses.analysis: This is the aggregate required-status-check, not an independent source failure. Its workflow explicitly exits 1 when needs.test-latest-deps.result is not success. The frozen evidence has exactly one underlying failed job, testLatestDeps2; all other selected checks passed. Correcting the Armeria 1.9 test expectation fixes that upstream cause without weakening the aggregate gate.

The new responseExceptionWithCauseIsReported test inferred the runtime Armeria version from the global testLatestDeps flag. The dedicated testArmeria19 suite and its preview variant retain Armeria 1.9.2 even when that flag is true. Before 1.10, HTTP/2 fallback reads a request log that does not preserve the attached response-control cause, so expecting ERROR in that pinned suite is incorrect. Detect the actual 1.10+ HttpResponseException.of(HttpResponse, Throwable) factory and reuse the lookup for exception construction and HTTP/2 expectations. HTTP/1 error reporting and modern HTTP/2 cause coverage are preserved. The exact frozen failure reproduced before the fix; the complete module check passed afterward with latest dependencies, including the pinned 1.9 preview suite.
evidence: Expected span [GET /response-exception-with-cause] to have status <ImmutableStatusData{statusCode=ERROR, description=}> but was <ImmutableStatusData{statusCode=UNSET, description=}>

report.scope: Structural/Git verification only. No target code or tests are executed.

Armeria uses directly thrown `HttpResponseException` to return responses, including HTTP 200. These control exceptions should not mark server spans as errors unless they carry a real cause.

- **Classification:** Skip error reporting for direct cause-less response exceptions; report attached causes through standard extraction. Wrapped exceptions retain normal failure reporting, and the original throwable is always rethrown.
- **Coverage:** Add integration regressions for successful response control, attached causes with baseline and latest dependencies, and wrapped failures, with separate HTTP/2 fallback expectations.
metadata.title: Fix Armeria synchronous response-control exception reporting
